studio.name: Studio Brain
studio.facts: Windows local website creation; editable files, accepted creator workflow and Film Desk included. Needs local Ollama, Node, Edge. Not a universal finished game/Roblox generator. Browser demos show its actual outputs.
tour: main
Explore the examples here. Film Desk, Nightshift and the game let you try real outputs before buying.

film.name: Studio Film Desk
film.facts: FREE BROWSER FILM MAKER: upload your photos, captions and optional owned audio; preview and export a real 720p WebM film without paying or installing Studio. WINDOWS UPGRADE: $19 Studio Brain includes Film Desk with MP4 and 1080p. Not a second purchase. Files stay on device.
tour: #title
Give your film a name. You can change the frame shape and seconds per photo below it.
#drop
Choose your photos here. They stay on your device. Arrange and caption them in the editor.
#export
Export your film when the preview looks right. Keep this tab open while it renders.

profitpilot.name: ProfitPilot
profitpilot.facts: Career builder/job finder. Free guided questions-to-options-to-action demo plus planner, real sourced Jobicy remote feed and application tracker. Paid Windows app adds local AI follow-ups, recommendations and adaptive next-step help; not automatic applications or guaranteed jobs.
tour: #journey
Start the guided path here. Your answers lead to possible directions and the next practical step.
#journey-content
Choose an answer that fits you. The next screen follows your choice; you can restart this path if you want to try another direction.
#get-copy
The full Windows edition adds local AI to adapt recommendations and next-step help. The browser path here stays free.

doctor.name: DoctorOne
doctor.facts: Project diagnostics with reactive robot. Browser sample/chosen-file path and Python-import checks run locally without changing files. Original Windows download free. No automatic repair or AI code diagnosis.
tour: #sample
Try the sample project first to see what the doctor looks for.
button[data-scan="scan"]
Run the check here. The report explains findings; nothing is repaired or executed.
#export
Save your report here after a scan.

novasafe.name: NovaSafe
novasafe.facts: FREE BROWSER: compare selected file bytes with SHA-256 and export report, no removal/moving. $3.99 WINDOWS: folder scans plus recoverable quarantine and non-overwriting restore; quarantine does not free disk space. No model required.
tour: #sample
Try the sample to see exact matches and same-size files that are different.
#scan
Compare the selected files. Only identical SHA-256 hashes count as exact copies.
#export
Download the report here. Moving files is only in the Windows edition, after your review.

game.name: Jumping Jack
game.facts: Working keyboard platformer, arrows or A/D to move, Space to jump, reach the beacon. Needs keyboard; no account. Standalone download available.
tour: iframe
Play in this frame: arrows or A/D to move, Space to jump. Reach the beacon. Click inside the game if keys are not responding.

creator.name: Nightshift Creator Desk
creator.facts: Browser workspace for content plans, client briefs, paid-request records and backup export. Local browser storage. Does not collect payments or send client messages.
tour: #content-title
Add a real title for your next piece of content here, then choose Add Content.
#client-alias
Record a client request here. Paid is a record you set, not a payment being collected.
button[data-action="export"]
Export your workspace here so you have a backup outside browser storage.

minglekind.name: MingleKind
minglekind.facts: Kinder community/connection app, existing externally hosted public application with its own account/access rules.

openheart.name: OpenHeart
openheart.facts: Adults 18+ connection/community app, own account rules. Existing Nova-hosted public app; public link maintained by Nova.

johnny.name: Johnny Law
johnny.facts: Constitution reader and recorder; posted through separate Homestead environment. Use app guidance, not legal advice. Not part of this upgrade repair scope.

seller.name: One Pic Seller
seller.facts: Free browser listing-prep workspace: photo cleanup, seller-fact draft, edits, download ZIP and saved selling board. Browser does not run AI image recognition. Free Windows local AI download uses Ollama qwen3-vl:2b-instruct. Manual marketplace posting links, owner-entered status and follow-up dates. No connected marketplace posting, buyer monitoring, automatic delisting or paid subscription is available.
tour: .hero
Choose a selling photo. Your original stays untouched; a separate JPEG is prepared.
#hint
Name the item and add the facts you know. The free browser edition uses your facts; the download adds local AI.
#category
Choose the category, then prepare your listing. Review its title, description and price before posting.
#board
Open saved items, follow up on your own listing records, or download a backup. Marketplace automation is not connected.
